housekeeping_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between housekeeping cycles. Increase for lower CPU usage, decrease for more responsive cleanup.

max_lbaas_per_housekeeping.description: Maximum number of Load Balancers processed per cycle. Limit to avoid overwhelming the system.

amphora_agent_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for amphora agent API calls during housekeeping. Increase if slow agents time out.

amphora_expiry_enabled.description: Whether to enable automatic expiry (deletion) of old, orphaned amphorae.

amphora_expiry_age.description: Minimum age (seconds) of an amphora before it's eligible for expiry. Default: 7 days (604800 seconds).

amphora_expiry_batch_size.description: Maximum number of amphorae expired in each batch. Smaller batches reduce load spikes.

amphora_agent_ca.description: Path to the CA certificate used to verify amphora agent TLS certificates.

amphora_agent_cert.description: Path to the amphora agent client certificate (for mutual TLS auth).

amphora_agent_key.description: Path to the amphora agent private key.

amphora_network.description: Neutron network ID used for amphora failover communication. Leave empty to use default.

amphora_subnet.description: Neutron subnet ID used for amphora failover communication. Leave empty to use default.

exclude_lba_ids.description: List of Load Balancer IDs to skip during housekeeping (e.g., critical or test LBs).

amphora_agent_heartbeat_dir.description: Directory where amphora heartbeat files are stored for health monitoring.

enable_health_sync.description: Enable syncing amphora health status to the Octavia database (required for health manager integration).

health_sync_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for RPC calls syncing amphora health data.

database_connection.description: Database connection string for the Octavia database (typically set via [database] section, but included for flexibility).

amphora_agents.description: Optional per-agent configuration overrides (advanced deployments with non-default agent configs).

name.description: Unique name/identifier for this amphora agent group.

host.description: IP address or hostname of the amphora agent.

port.description: Port the amphora agent is listening on (default 9443 for TLS).

use_tls.description: Whether to use TLS for communication with this agent group.

lock_path.description: Directory for filesystem locks to coordinate housekeeping across multiple workers.

workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for housekeeping tasks. Increase on high-LB-count deployments.

thread_pool_size.description: Size of the thread pool per worker for asynchronous I/O.

use_eventlet.description: Enable eventlet-based green threads (recommended for I/O-bound services like this).

amphora_driver.description: Name of the amphora management driver (usually left as default).

loadbalancer_topology.description: Topology mode for load balancer distribution. Common values: SINGLE, ACTIVE_STANDBY.
